🌙 LUNAR PULSE is coming to PAX West 2026! 🌙
After making its playable demo debut at gamescom, LUNAR PULSE is heading to North America! 🎮✨
We’re excited to announce that LUNAR PULSE will be featured at PAX West 2026, giving players the chance to step into the world of the game and experience it for themselves.
📍 Arch Building | Booth 817 | 04 - 07 Sep, 2026
🤝 JETRO Booth
Come by, play the demo, and grab some exclusive swag while you’re there! 🎁
We’d love to see you at PAX West and introduce you to LUNAR PULSE. 🌙
✨ Add LUNAR PULSE to your wishlist and stay tuned for more!

Day 1 at kicef 2026! 🇰🇷

GIANTY had the chance to meet and connect with businesses and potential partners from different industries.

This time, we’re looking for the right partners to build our ecosystem and explore new markets, especially across Physical AI, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Education.

One interesting discovery today: we came across a HealthTech company using materials made in Vietnam. 🇻🇳 A small but surprising detail that shows Vietnam’s growing presence in the global technology and supply chain ecosystem.

And of course, Tengos AI - Multilingual AI Assistant for Work and Study has been getting lots of attention from visitors and exhibitors! With its real-time translation, Tengos makes communication and connection easier, breaking down language barriers right at the event. 🥰

Two more days to connect, discover, and explore new opportunities! 👀

GIANTY at AI Agent DXPO Tokyo 2026

Two days of conversations, connections, and exploring new possibilities with AI.
On August 20–21, GIANTY participated in AI Agent DXPO Tokyo ’26【Summer】 at Tokyo Big Sight. It was a great opportunity for us to showcase our AI solutions while connecting with businesses, developers, and technology enthusiasts. 🤝

At the GIANTY booth, visitors had the opportunity to explore Doraverse, Tengos AI, Mimi (a voice chat AI for elderly care), as well as our AI-powered development solutions.

Thank you to everyone who visited our booth and took the time to connect with the GIANTY team!

🎮 LUNAR PULSE is coming to gamescom 2026!
GIANTY is excited to share that LUNAR PULSE, a game GIANTY is co-developing with Fahrenheit 213 (213F), will make its first playable demo appearance at gamescom 2026 in Cologne, Germany, through the JETRO Pavilion.
This special demo is designed to give players a first-hand look at the core tactical mechanics of LUNAR PULSE:
⚡ Fast-Paced Duels: Intense one-on-one battles against CPU opponents, with each match lasting approximately one minute.
🃏 Open-Hand Strategy: Each player has a 15-card deck and a 5-card hand, with both players’ hands fully revealed throughout the battle.
🧠 Simultaneous Action Selection: Both sides choose their actions at the same time, challenging you to read the situation, anticipate your opponent’s next move, and make the right decision.
Event Details:
 📍 JETRO Pavilion | Hall 10.2 · E043g · Indie Area
 📅 August 26–30, 2026
 🎮 Demo available in English, Japanese, and German
GIANTY will continue sharing more updates throughout gamescom 2026, so stay tuned!

reviews.text: Tôi có dịp làm việc trực tiếp với đội ngũ ở đây và cảm nhận rõ sự chuyên nghiệp trong cách phối hợp. Chất lượng bàn giao chỉn chu, đúng những gì đã thống nhất và tiến độ cũng được giữ khá ổn định nên tôi yên tâm trong suốt quá trình làm việc. Có những lúc cao điểm nếu phản hồi nhanh hơn một chút nữa thì sẽ càng thuận tiện, nhưng nhìn chung đây là một đối tác đáng tin cậy, tôi sẵn sàng giới thiệu cho đồng nghiệp hoặc khách hàng khi có nhu cầu tương tự.
